svg.title: AI Safety Atlas: twenty selected organizations in eight countries
svg.desc: Map and alphabetical lists of ten commercial companies and ten research organizations in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, China, Japan, Singapore and Australia. Teal circles represent companies; ochre diamonds represent research organizations. Filled A–D badges show primary activity and outlined badges supporting activity. © 2026 Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. CC BY 4.0.
